# Skeletal physics projects the bone chain before resolving world target points

**Problem-only Draft.** Production source on `main@e89349ca51b4e9d024c194cd3bdf645bd25b6c37`. This is the root bodies generated by a ragdoll profile, not the parented post-solver writeback in #145. No test, executable result or production change at this stage.

1. **Difference.** ZE's [profile spawn](../../../zircon_plugins/physics/runtime/src/skeletal/profile.rs#L271-L335) and [animated drive](../../../zircon_plugins/physics/runtime/src/skeletal/runtime.rs#L149-L191) start with a projected skeleton world TRS and compose successive bone/offset TRS. UE resolves a live bone's world transform before providing it to the body or kinematic target, rather than treating a bone- or component-relative point as the world target. The ZE hierarchy authority is its full affine matrix.
2. **Potential impact.** For a skeleton with world linear `diag(2,1,1) * Ry(45°)`, a bone at local `+X` should produce a world displacement `(+√2,0,-1/√2)`. The old projection can place its root body elsewhere. Nonuniform scale followed by a child bone rotation can also misplace a nonzero body offset even when the skeleton entity is a root. Incorrect successive world points imply incorrect inherited linear velocity at release to simulation. These are analytic predictions pending native results.
3. **Cause and Unreal evidence.** [ZE world TRS](../../../zircon_runtime/src/scene/world/derived_state.rs#L450-L462) is a reduction of the true matrix, and [componentwise bone composition](../../../zircon_plugins/physics/runtime/src/skeletal/runtime.rs#L460-L465) cannot carry the shear to a later offset. UE `Engine/Source/Runtime/Engine/Private/SkeletalMeshComponentPhysics.cpp:919–928,1071–1084` supplies `GetBoneTransform` to `InitBody`; `Components/SkinnedMeshComponent.cpp:2441–2450,2502–2510` uses the resolved component-to-world transform. The adjacent *matrix* getter (`2391–2432`) composes the bone and component matrices before returning. In `PhysicsEngine/PhysAnim.cpp:683–711` the world bone pose reaches `SetKinematicTarget_AssumesLocked` or `SetGlobalPose_AssumesLocked`; `Experimental/PhysScene_Chaos.cpp:1782–1787` forwards the target. UE explicitly warns on nonuniform scale and approximates body scale (`PhysAnim.cpp:616–622,713–730`); this is not proof that UE physics or `FTransform` supports shear.
4. **Rust direction.** After a genuine old RED, preserve the full matrix while resolving `skeleton_world * bone_chain * body_offset` for the world point. Keep the old rigid rotation and scale policy, as well as the existing bone resolution, topological order and finite checks. Measure linear release from two exact world points; do not reinterpret that as verifying angular velocity or a sheared primitive. Do not change the reverse simulated-pose feed or manually parented body writeback without an independent witness.
5. **Interface and ECS.** [Profile configuration](../../../zircon_plugins/physics/runtime/src/skeletal/profile.rs#L412-L460) uses independent ECS bodies and joint metadata, not scene parenting of bones. [Runtime animated drive](../../../zircon_plugins/physics/runtime/src/runtime_system.rs#L91-L109) precedes the physics step. Validate the real profile and driver in existing unit tests, not a parallel runtime or ABI. Prefab, live solver, ECS hierarchy, public profiles and #145 stay unchanged.
6. **Concrete gate.** Extend the existing skeletal unit test module and preserve its [spawn/control](../../../zircon_plugins/physics/runtime/src/skeletal/tests/cases.rs#L28-L95) and [no-pop/release](../../../zircon_plugins/physics/runtime/src/skeletal/tests/cases.rs#L126-L174) assertions. Port the position-and-velocity observation from local UE HeadlessChaos `EngineInterface.SetKinematicTargetWriteBackEnabled/Disabled` (`Engine/Source/Programs/HeadlessChaos/Private/HeadlessChaosTestPhysicsScene.cpp:1387–1419,1432–1458,1498–1508`). Assert real spawned root points, parent bone vs parent **body offset** distinction, animated drive positions, unchanged last point on release, and `Δworld / Δt` separately. Use a rigid control and record genuine old behavioral failures before edits. A direct driver unit test is not a hosted Update or Chaos/Jolt solver run.
